entries.text: You’ll see what the Gym Test is all about once\nyou go outside.
entries.label: gym_denki_015_receptionist_01

entries.text: Ladies aaand gentlemens! It’s time for the\nIono Zone![VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_00

entries.text: Hey, hey, heyyy![VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_01

entries.text: Your eyeballs are MINE—caught in my\nElectroweb! Whosawhatsit? Iono! I’m the Gym\r\nLeader here! ’Ello, ’ello, hola! Ciao and bonjour![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_02

entries.text: The Gym Leader?!
entries.label: gym_denki_015_select_01

entries.text: ’Ello, ’ello, hola! Ciao and bonjour!
entries.label: gym_denki_015_select_02

entries.text: Indeedy-doo! I kick it as Gym Leader when I’m\nnot producin’ sweet content on the internet as an\r\ninfluencer to bring dreams to the masses![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_03a

entries.text: Oh snap! Look at you—already a master of\nIono-ese! Not your first rodeo, then, eh?[VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_03b

entries.text: And, uh...I hope this doesn’t come as too much of\na surprise, but you’re bein’ broadcast live to the\r\nworld right now! Smile![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_03

entries.text: Anywho, challenger! Thanks for coming out to the\nLevincia Gym to see me![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_04

entries.text: I’m super happy you’re here, but I’m also a bit of\na celeb, ya know? I’m all kiiinds of busy![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_05

entries.text:
So I can’t collab with you unless I know you can
bring in those sweet, sweet viewer numb—\c
Er, I mean, I gotta make sure you can bring
some real passion to my stream! Nyohoho![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_06

entries.text: And! So! If you wanna battle me, you’re gonna\nhave to help me make this livestream a viral hit\r\nfirst! Got it?[VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_07

entries.text: I can tell you just can’t wait to get started! Well,\nwell, WELL then! Allow me to explain the plan![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_08

entries.text: Come on out, Mr. Walksabout![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_20

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. What a
coincidence,
meeting
you here.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_head_teacher_01

entries.text: Say whaaat?! D’you guys know each other\nor somethin’?[VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_09

entries.text: This here dude had a real aura about him when\nhe was walkin’ down the street, so I snatched him\r\nup for my dealio here![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_17

entries.text: You are, er, too kind. Ha ha ha...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_head_teacher_02

entries.text: Well anywho, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c\nSince you’re today’s challenger, I’mma have you\nplay hide-and-seek with Mr. Walksabout here![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_18

entries.text: Look for the good gentleman using the street\nsurveillance cameras! Find ’im three times, and\r\nyou can consider this Gym Test passed![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_10

entries.text: We need a better name for this challenge,\nthough! I’ll call it...\c\n“Where in Levincia Is Mr. Walksabout?”![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_11

entries.text: Y’think that title’s safe? There’s nothing iffy\nabout it or anything, right?[VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_12

entries.text: Eh, whatevs! I ’unno ’bout you, but I’m ready to\ngo! Get ready to hide, Mr. Walksabout![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_denki_13

entries.text:
I feel that I owe the Pokémon League for many
a past favor, so I am more than happy to help.\c
Do bear with me as I try my best in my
allocated role.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: gym_denki_015_head_teacher_03
